M1_P1.implementation: Paired N2 GEMM with RF epilogues; independent batch attention occupies disjoint halves of the sixteen SMs. Batch1 K/V export waits for the corresponding batch0 head export, while attention computation still overlaps across the two SM groups. Decode WO/W2 use N16/K128/single GEMM to fill all SMs, backed by cold microbench improvement. All LN hoist gamma/beta into RF6/7 before row loop. Keep exported prompt K/V in RF3/RF5, use transposed RF key view and RF value view for both attention query tiles, removing HBM rereads without arithmetic changes. Algebraically regroup tanh GELU to six instructions (FP32 rounding changes only). Prompt W2 only uses M64/N16/K32 single: two M groups reduce duplicated B transfer, all sixteen SMs active. Prompt W1 weights remain in 32 workgroup RFs for all M rows; two workgroups per SM. Output copies are row-sharded before STEP.COMMIT. Prompt QKV perSM N48 full-K resident, K32 preload waves, M16 accumulators and split N32/N16 MMAs. Cache disabled; W1 K32 preload waves with global joins; RF-resident attention query8 and five-stage per-row softmax issue pipeline.

M2_D1.implementation: Resident new KV in owner RF3; redundant softmax per history shard eliminates probability HBM round trip; owner partial retained in RF. Head-local score and partial WAIT dependencies replace global attention barriers. Same-SM dense preload dependencies; fused LayerNorm affine/variance and GELU half-shift arithmetic. Wide TC W2 uses N16 columns and two K256 shards per output; eight owners combine the partials before bias and residual.

M1_P1.implementation: Exact joint27 W2-owner RF kernel retained. Minimal cache0 power repairs: prompt QKV full-K resident N48 per SM; prompt W1 K32 synchronized preload slices into the same K64 resident RF views; prompt WO N16 full-K resident; decode WO/W1/W2 bounded K-wave loads with arithmetic overlap. Attention query32, GELU, all remaining compiler arithmetic, hardware and D1 are unchanged from joint27. No softmax query8 merge or additional optimization.

M2_D1.implementation: Resident new KV in owner RF3; redundant softmax per history shard eliminates probability HBM round trip; owner partial retained in RF. Head-local score and partial WAIT dependencies replace global attention barriers. Same-SM dense preload dependencies; fused LayerNorm affine/variance and GELU half-shift arithmetic. Stable distributed online softmax combines four local maxima, denominators, and unnormalized contexts; no score HBM exchange. First-use K-chunk weight loads alternate with actual GEMM accumulation; all weight chunks are retained for the other seven decode steps. LN coefficients and history are loaded at first use. The final FFN epilogue directly stores its disjoint column shards to the released public hidden output, eliminating the scratch copy. One K=3 MMA merges the other three weighted attention partials. Wide TC W2 uses N16 columns and two K256 shards per output; eight owners combine the partials before bias and residual.

M1_P1.implementation: 32 个逻辑工作组各占一个物理 SM，保留原权重分片及算术顺序。W1 的 N32 分片与 W2 的两路 K512 分片从每 SM 两组改为每 SM 一组；QKV、WO、attention 及两行 decode 仍使用原 16 分片。

M2_D1.implementation: 32 SM 稠密分片：QKV N12、WO N4、W1 N16；W2 为 16 个 N8 输出分片乘两路 K256，16 个 owner 归并并融合偏置残差。历史 attention 保留四头各四个分片及原归并算术；新增 attention 工作组仅计算稠密投影。每个消费者仍本地归一化。

static_resource_account.basis: 官方 hardware.py、cost_v04.json、service.py 的纯静态公式；不是模拟、实测延迟或因果等待证据。
static_resource_account.selected_template: 32 SM、每 SM 一个 4x8 K2 TC、4R2W；其余硬件字段保持本次输入基线。固定部分 0.3+8*0.05+512*0.0005=0.956 mm²；每 SM 0.70062277088 mm²。
static_resource_account.screened_alternative: 24 SM、8x8 K1、4R2W、其余同基线，面积 18.06924826112 mm²；D1 的 N128/N512 不能均匀分为 24 个整列分片，本次选可整除的 32 SM 模板。此事实不否证非均匀 24 SM 设计。
static_resource_account.p1_mapping: 原 32 个工作组的 RF 与权重不变，原 sm=shard%16 改为 sm=shard%32；W1 与 W2 两路 K 分片从两组共享 SM 改为独占。其余原 16 分片算子无新增并行度，较小阵列可能使其退化。
static_resource_account.p1_rf_service: 同一 W1 MMA(32,32,64)：基线 TC=259 周期、RF读=53248 B、写=4096 B、端口服务下界=416 周期；候选 TC=1027、读=102400 B、写=4096 B、端口服务下界=1600。可并行组数翻倍不能证明抵消这些成本。原 W2 partial 的 HBM 载荷不变，归并由原同 SM 两组改为跨 SM，实际 NoC 服务由 worker 检查。
static_resource_account.d1_attention: 保留 16 个历史分片，每组 RF7 两份1024元素，不在新增分片加载或处理不存在的 head；每头的4路稳定归并保持原算术顺序，attention 没有新增并行收益。
static_resource_account.d1_w2_service: 旧 N16 K128 MMA：TC=67、RF读8768 B、写64 B、端口服务下界69周期；新 N8 K128：TC=67、RF读4640 B、写32 B、端口服务下界73周期。32组取代16组，每条局部MMA没有TC延迟收益；每批RF总读由140288增至148480 B。
static_resource_account.d1_traffic: W2 每次调用紧凑输入加载从16*256*4=16384 B增至32*256*4=32768 B；两路K拆分仍写+读各128元素，归并载荷仍1024 B，但消息数从8+8增至16+16。两次LayerNorm每层每步输入载荷由2*16*128*4=16384 B增至32768 B；本地归一化RF/向量工作量也翻倍。以上为逻辑载荷，不能等同实际HBM或NoC传输。
static_resource_account.domain: 仅调 hardware.rf_ports ∈ {4R2W,2R1W} 与 hardware.sm_noc_bytes_per_cycle ∈ {128,64}；固定32SM及4x8 K2阵列，两案开关固定开启。三个非基准组合均面积合格；程序映射相同。
static_resource_account.hypothesis: 潜在收益只来自已拆分工作组的并发及稠密列分片变小；综合收益未知。若双案资格或收益不满足清单停止条件，不扩大搜索。

M1_P1.implementation: 十六 lane RF 成对分区重排；跨界矩形 MMA 和传输拆分，原完成事件显式汇合。

M2_D1.implementation: 十六 lane RF 成对分区重排；跨界矩形 MMA 和传输拆分，原完成事件显式汇合。
